name: Tolbutamide

similar.name: Sulfacarbamide
problems: Pulled from the market in Germany, first in 1988 — for liver harm and blood problems

examples.title: A Drug Interaction Study of Tasisulam in Patients With Advanced Cancer or Lymphoma
examples.why: Terminated based on safety results from another trial

summary: According to a small computer model rather than human testing, Tolbutamide received a high risk score for the liver and a low risk score for the heart [M]. A similar drug, Sulfacarbamide, was pulled from the market in Germany starting in 1988 because it caused harm to the liver and blood [3]. Additionally, a clinical trial involving Tolbutamide was stopped early based on safety findings from a different trial [5].
